item.title: Group report totals by currency
item.brief: Update Python report CLI for the shared currency contract. Parse currency-bearing CSV as provided, accept legacy CSV without currency as USD, validate currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, and on malformed currency print stderr error and exit 2. Output header account,currency,total_cents and totals grouped/sorted by account then currency. Update README and preserve tests. Run `python3 -m unittest` and add/adjust focused tests for legacy/default, multiple currencies, sorting and malformed code/status.

item.title: Add transaction currency column to ledger
item.brief: Update the Rust TSV-to-CSV CLI for the shared currency contract. Accept existing three-column TSV as USD and optional fourth currency field, validate exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, emit four-column CSV with currency. On invalid currency write an error naming the input line to stderr and exit 2; keep other input errors at status 1. Update README and preserve tests. Run `cargo test` and add/adjust focused tests for default, valid currency, invalid code with line number/status.

state.summary:
Added optional TSV currency support to ledger: omitted values default to USD, supplied values must be exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, and CSV now includes the currency column. Invalid currency reports its input line and exits 2; other malformed input remains status 1.
